Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Jordan Neill and Ryan Hunter to open for Ireland. Naman Tiwari to bowl first. Let's play...
...THE CHASE...

Ireland were excellent to begin with, Oliver Riley, John McNally and Carson McCullough were really good but they will be disappointed with how they finished. They just could not control the onslaught and bowled far too many bad balls and extras. Now their batters face a massive task ahead against this strong Indian bowling attack. They will need to bat really well if they are to chase this down. India on the other hand, will expect themselves to defend this.

End of a top batting effort from the Indians and we believe, they have batted Ireland out of the game. Yes, they are yet to bat but we believe this is a little too much for them. The start though was slow going for the Indians and when they lost their second wicket, they were in a spot of bother but Musheer Khan and Uday Saharan batted brilliantly. They added around 150. They started off slowly but as the game went on, stepped on the gas. Musheer Khan scored an excellent ton and Uday Saharan played as the perfect foil. India never looked like crossing 300 but excellent cameos from the lower order helped them do so.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets to end but 15 from the over. On middle, Murugan Abhishek looks to play the slog sweep but it goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket and it is taken. India Under-19 END WITH 301!

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. Time for the national anthems first. It will be Ireland's first followed by that of India. Time for action now. The Irish players are in a huddle near the fence. Now they spread out to their respective position. Adarsh Singh and Arshin Kulkarni to open for India. Spin to start, it is Scott MacBeth with the new ball. Let's play...
Uday Saharan says they would have batted first. Shares there were lot of learning from the last game. Reckons they are ready to defend the title. Informs about the three changes in the XI.
Philippus le Roux says they will bowl first. Adds the ball did a bit in the last match and hopes to start well and do the same in this game as well. Informs about the team changes.

India Under-19 (PLAYING XI) - Adarsh Singh, Arshin Kulkarni, Musheer Khan, Uday Saharan (C), Sachin Dhas, Priyanshu Moliya, Aravelly Rao (WK), Murugan Abhishek, Saumy Pandey, Naman Tiwari, Dhanush Gowda (In for Raj Limbani).

Ireland Under-19 (PLAYING XI) - Jordan Neill, Ryan Hunter (WK), Kian Hilton, Philippus le Roux (C), Scott MacBeth, Macdara Cosgrave (In for Gavin Roulston), John McNally, Carson McCullough, Oliver Riley, Daniel Forkin (In for Reuben Wilson), Finn Lutton (In for Matthew Weldon).
TOSS - Ireland Under-19 have won the toss and will BOWL first!

Hello and welcome to match number 15 where India Under-19 will take on Ireland Under-19. The favorites of this tournament, India won their first game comprehensively against Bangladesh and will look to make it two in two here against Ireland who are coming into this game on the back of the loss. They started the tournament with a brilliant win against the USA however, lost by a very small margin against Bangladesh. Ireland Under-19 look really solid on paper but they are coming against a team who are high on confidence and will be keen to put on a brilliant show again. Who do you think will win? Let's find out.
